all.title: No conversations yet
all.description: When someone messages your WhatsApp number or replies to an email, the conversation shows up here.

mine.title: Nothing assigned to you
mine.description: Conversations with your leads and contacts land here. Pick one up from Unassigned in the meantime.

unassigned.title: Every conversation has an owner
unassigned.description: New chats from unknown numbers appear here until someone takes them.

unread.title: You're all caught up
unread.description: New messages will show up here the moment they arrive.

search.title: Nothing matches "{{q}}"
search.description: Try a first name, the last digits of a phone number, or a word from the chat.

home.title: Pick a conversation
home.waiting_one: {{count}} conversation has unread messages. Replies go out on the channel the person used.
home.waiting_other: {{count}} conversations have unread messages. Replies go out on the channel the person used.
home.caughtUp: You're all caught up. Replies go out on the channel the person used, and every message lands on their timeline.
home.windowHint: After someone messages you on WhatsApp, you have 24 hours to reply freely.
home.templateHint: Once that window closes, WhatsApp only allows approved templates until they write again.

thread.noMessagesDescription: Start with an approved template. Once they reply, you can write freely for 24 hours.

message.failed: Not delivered. Check the number and try again.

window.closing: Reply window closes in {{time}}. Reply now to keep the chat open.
window.closed: The 24-hour reply window closed {{ago}}. WhatsApp only allows approved templates until {{name}} replies.
window.never: {{name}} hasn't messaged you on WhatsApp yet. Start with an approved template; once they reply you can write freely.
window.progressLabel: Time left in the 24-hour reply window

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholderLocked: Free-form replies are paused until {{name}} replies
composer.hint: Press Enter to send and Shift + Enter for a new line.

templates.title: Send a template to {{name}}
templates.description: Templates are approved by Meta, so you can send them at any time, even after the 24-hour window.
templates.emptyDescription: Templates are submitted and approved in WhatsApp Manager. Approved ones appear here automatically.

toasts.windowClosed: The 24-hour window closed. Send an approved template instead.
